author: Dodo No More
AEGIS Game Studios
install_msg: Thank you for installing AGSVRoleKick. Load it with `[p]load agsvrolekick`, then use `[p]help agsrolekick`.
name: AGSVRoleKick
short: Kick all members with a specified role, with blacklist safeguards.
description: A bot-owner-only Red cog that manually kicks members who have a specified role. Includes DM-before-kick, role/user blacklists, persistent settings, reporting, permission checks, and Red ModLog case creation.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild configuration only: report channel ID, invite link, blacklisted role IDs, and blacklisted user IDs. It does not store kicked member records persistently.
